# PhaseCodedRepresentation

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
Representation of information using the relative phases of oscillators, allowing complex-valued patterns to be encoded in synchronization states. Exploits phase dynamics for efficient, low-power computation in TCC and iNEST architectures.
